tls.revoke.body.global:
Glowfly will set http.schannelCheckRevoke to best-effort in your global settings, for every repository.

With best-effort, Git still refuses a certificate known to be revoked. It goes on when the revocation server can't be reached or the certificate names none.

What you give up: a revoked (e.g. stolen) certificate could be accepted while its revocation server is unreachable. Setting false instead turns revocation checks off altogether, and Glowfly doesn't offer that.
